title: Understanding PCA
text: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to emphasize variation and bring out strong patterns in a dataset. It identifies the directions (principal components) in which the data varies the most.

title: Identifying PC $$1$$
text: The first principal component (PC 1) is the direction in which the data varies the most. It is the line that best fits the data in the least squares sense.

title: Slope of PC $$1$$
text: Look at the scatter plot. The slope of PC $$1$$ should match the general trend of the data points. It should be a line that goes through the center of the data cloud.
